description: Executable single-Spark Candidate for Google's exact instruction-tuned Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint on the pinned vLLM 0.30 ARM64 runtime, with bounded local-image chat and reasoning. The original vllm-single recipe remains available as the fallback profile until physical Spark canary acceptance. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B IT vLLM 0.30 single Spark
